channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Republican Governor Phil Scott won a historic sixth term as Vermont governor with Molly Gray winning as lieutenant governor. Democrats flipped multiple legislative seats across the state.
Lincoln, Vermont had a New York City parking ticket rescinded. The ticket was for a five-ton wheel-loader that never left the garage. New York City officials admitted the error and canceled the fine.

Rutland officials approved an extra eighty-one thousand dollars to fund an accessibility trail project at Pine Hill and Giorgetti parks. The total budget is now about five hundred thousand dollars, with grants expected to cover half. The trail will be wider and flatter to accommodate less-mobile users.
New York State Police are investigating fatal crashes in Putnam and Granville. Authorities have not released full details yet.
